# Observability

XRLEnv exposes the same state through a browser admin panel, CLI
commands, Prometheus metrics, and structured logs. Use these pages
when a cluster is already running and you need to answer what is
healthy, busy, stuck, or filling disk.

- {doc}`admin_panel`
- {doc}`admin_auth`
- {doc}`metrics`
